purpose: First conditional spatial diagnostic on the qualified565 Late Roman70–324 residential site IDs. Test fixed native-grid population-pattern covariates against a simple same-source uniform-land baseline; do not infer absolute people or city counts.
observations: Use exactly the independently reviewed source SiteIDs, own-primary-source polygons and phase/type/quality rules in output/roman_regional_sources_20261117. Preserve all eight named survey strata. Counts within each stratum condition the comparison; they are not predictions or inter-survey density measurements.
fixed_fields: Read original Roman9km grid geometry/land and frozen legacy density from output/settlement_locations_20261110/rome_inputs.npz. Reconstruct the already reviewed refreshed floodplain settlement-base density from the exact restored/grid/earth.npz with the existing earth_people arithmetic sampler, matching its fixed recipe. No refit, climate/harvest engine, route or demographic solve. Label the original field legacy, the updated H-source field refreshed, and uniform land baseline. This is a population-pattern covariate diagnostic, not the urban-town generator scored on farmsteads.
geometry: Use the original spherical azimuthal-equidistant model grid centred40N17E,9km cells and the existing land mask. Source EPSG32636 polygons and point geometry determine support. Clip exact per-source polygons against native cells with1km densification of source edges; retain intersections and their planar-model areas. Report model-projection area separately from source UTM area. No site buffers, convex hull, whole bounding-box support or resolution tuning.
support: Before scoring report all per-source intersected/occupied cells, point collisions, off-grid/off-land sites and positive-area land support. Native cell assignment uses the same original grid centre/half-cell boundary convention. Keep excluded unsupported observations visible; do not relocate them to nearest land. Counts condition only on model-supported land observations, and removals limit interpretation.
observation_model: Within each source assume observation opportunity uniform over its retained model-land polygon intersection. This assumption is NOT historically qualified: walking intensity, visibility and settlement-to-population links remain unknown. Predictions are normalized within each source so heterogeneous source totals do not masquerade as ecological density skill.
metrics: Fixed per-source cell probabilities p(cell)=intersection_area*weight/sum(intersection_area*weight), with weight1 uniform, legacy density or refreshed density. Exact conditional log likelihood against uniform baseline per retained site; report literal negative infinity if a positive-count cell has zero model intensity, without pseudocount. Also report weighted AUC using occupied versus all retained-area cells with tie half-credit. Primary summary equal-source mean log-likelihood gain, pooled-site gain secondary; retain every source, including small samples and uninformative fields. No p-values or calibrated confidence claim from clustered source points.
checks: Verify original model-grid centre coordinates against its projection, source frame/IDs/land controls, matching normalized probabilities and exact counts, independent scalar area/score review and fresh exports. Reconstruct refreshed input recipe control before interpretation. This later diagnostic explicitly assumes a proportional link between a population-pattern field and recorded habitation-site intensity; a score is not a direct population validation.
exposure: No new blind or independent-geographic claim. Source observations and Roman regional geography are exposed. Present conditional assumption limits with every result.
exclusions: No parameter selection by score, extra model alternatives, phase/quality/subsource sweeps, fine-grid rerun, population estimate, hierarchy fit, food/work/climate/route solve or atlas update.
